message.jaymospowers.zfighter_flare: Everything goes quiet, and then gold. A flare of power you can't hold for long.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_flare_end: It gives out. Your legs go and the ki with it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_flare_hold: The flare won't climb. Hold on, or sneak and press C to let it go.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_golden: The fur burns gold. The ape is quieter this time, and stronger.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_god_enter: The fire goes still. Red hair, a calm, clear power.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_instinct_r: Your god form is mastered enough for silver instinct: tap Z in it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_instinct_u: Silver instinct needs the god form %s%% mastered.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_instinct_r: Your body can't read the fight again for %s seconds.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_instinct_o: Silver. The body moves before the thought.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_legendary_: Something in your blood runs hotter than your people's. A line of forms that isn't Super waits in you, huge and green and not easily held.
The rage gets away from you!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_nee: The circle needs five of good heart (%s of %s).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_beg: The ring lends you its ki. Hold still.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_len: You lend your ki to %s. Stay on your pad.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_tha: %s rose into the god form on your ki. (+%s TP)
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_don: %s is lifted into a god form, red-haired and calm, on the ki of five.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_bro: The ritual falls apart: the one in the middle moved, or his heart was not true.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_fel: The ritual falls apart: someone left the ring, or their heart was not true.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ritual_dry: The ritual falls apart: a lender ran out of ki.
